answer: Each epoch the protocol posts D, distinct graders who sealed last close, and R, its rows. An unestablished submit burns B=ceil(R/D)*(U+1) units of this epoch's per-head payout, locked to that key and struck at close. Twenty rows and ten graders cost a lone joiner 2; after nine unestablished, the tenth burns 20. Last close's grader set cannot be minted, split, or pre-aged, so the next head pays a higher multiple of the same R/D unit. One sparrow still pays the unit price. An old lantern does not restock D, and the vertex of the ladder is live occupancy U.
